label: Period Wardrobe
description: What the era actually put on a body, tagged by period so a variant can couple it to the matching hair, place and film.

items.name: flapper-drop-waist
items.text: a drop-waist beaded chemise that skims rather than shapes, fringe hem swinging a half-beat behind the body, silk stockings rolled below the knee

items.name: cloche-and-coat
items.text: a wool cloche pulled to the eyebrows over a shingled bob, worn with a wrapped collar coat fastened at one hip by a single oversized button

items.name: black-tie-tails
items.text: white tie and tails cut long in the body, wing collar and piqué waistcoat, the whole silhouette narrow and vertical

items.name: workwear-1920s
items.text: a collarless union shirt under wide braces, heavy moleskin trousers gone soft at the knee, a flat cap that has taken the shape of its owner
items.text_short: braces, moleskin and a flat cap

items.name: service-dress
items.text: a wool service tunic pressed at the shoulders and worn at the elbows, brass buttons dulled deliberately, webbing belt bearing the weight of everything

items.name: utility-suit
items.text: a rationed utility suit built to a government pattern — square shoulders, no turn-ups, the exact number of buttons allowed and not one more

items.name: factory-coveralls
items.text: denim factory coveralls rolled to the forearm, hair bound up in a knotted scarf against the machinery, steel-toed boots laced tight

items.name: flight-jacket
items.text: a sheepskin flight jacket zipped to the chin, collar turned up, the leather cracked white along every fold it has ever made

items.name: full-skirt-day-dress
items.text: a cotton day dress with a fitted bodice and a skirt held wide by stiff petticoats, narrow patent belt, white gloves to the wrist

items.name: grey-flannel-suit
items.text: a grey flannel suit with natural shoulders and a narrow lapel, white shirt, slim dark tie, hat brim snapped down at the front
items.text_short: grey flannel suit and snap-brim hat

items.name: rolled-cuff-denim
items.text: a white t-shirt with the sleeve rolled once, selvedge denim turned up thick at the ankle, engineer boots scuffed at the toe

items.name: circle-skirt-diner
items.text: a felt circle skirt and fitted twin-set, saddle shoes with folded bobby socks, a cardigan buttoned only at the throat

items.name: wide-lapel-suit
items.text: a wide-lapel suit in warm brown, flared trousers breaking over stacked heels, shirt collar spread across the jacket like wings

items.name: prairie-dress
items.text: a prairie dress in small floral cotton, ruffled yoke and long full sleeves gathered at a narrow cuff, hem to the boot

items.name: denim-on-denim
items.text: a denim jacket over high-waisted flares in a different, harder wash, embroidery climbing one leg, a wide tooled belt between them

items.name: halter-jersey
items.text: a jersey halter dress cut on the bias so it moves with the room, gold at the throat, hair parted dead centre

items.name: power-shoulder
items.text: a boxy blazer with shoulders built out past the frame, worn over a silk blouse with a bow at the neck and a pencil skirt to the knee

items.name: neon-activewear
items.text: a neon leotard over footless tights, slouch socks pushed down over trainers, a headband holding back volume that fights it

items.name: leather-and-stonewash
items.text: a cropped leather jacket with the sleeves pushed up, stonewashed jeans tapered hard at the ankle, white high-tops kept deliberately clean

items.name: double-breasted-eighties
items.text: a double-breasted suit in a chalk stripe, jacket wide and long, braces visible when it opens, tie knotted thick

items.name: layered-salvage
items.text: layered salvage worn in the order it was found — a quilted liner under a canvas coat under a harness, every strap doing a job someone chose

items.name: patched-workwear
items.text: workwear patched with whatever held: mismatched denim panels, a boot sole stitched on at the shoulder as armour, cuffs bound with wire

items.name: dust-wrap
items.text: a wrapped head-cloth and goggles pushed up on the forehead, a scarf hauled down off the mouth, dust settled into every seam

items.name: scavenger-armour
items.text: plate cut from road signs and lashed over a padded jacket, the reflective face turned inward, one shoulder built up heavier than the other
